set_value.name: $_TSEDefaultOrderParamRef
set_value.exact: if this.ship.defaultorder.id == 'Assist' then this.ship.commander.defaultorder else this.ship.defaultorder

debug_to_file.name: $_TSETraceFile
debug_to_file.text: '[TSE-TRACE] source=idle_follow ship=%1 phase=lifecycle event=order_start result=active target=%2 target_sector=%3 strictblacklist=%4 useknownpath=%5'.[this.ship.idcode, $target, @$target.sector.knownname, $STRICT_BLACKLIST, $USE_KNOWN_PATH]

debug_to_file.name: $_TSETraceFile
debug_to_file.text: '[TSE-TRACE] source=idle_follow ship=%1 phase=move event=move_start result=pending target=%2 target_sector=%3 strictblacklist=%4 useknownpath=%5'.[this.ship.idcode, $target, @$target.sector.knownname, $STRICT_BLACKLIST, $USE_KNOWN_PATH]

debug_to_file.name: $_TSETraceFile
debug_to_file.text: '[TSE-TRACE] source=idle_follow ship=%1 phase=move event=move_return result=%2 reason=%3 target=%4 current_sector=%5 target_sector=%6'.[this.ship.idcode, $movesuccess, if $movesuccess then 'success' else 'follow_failed', $target, this.ship.sector.knownname, @$target.sector.knownname]

debug_to_file.name: $_TSETraceFile
debug_to_file.text: '[TSE-TRACE] source=idle_follow ship=%1 phase=interrupt event=target_changed result=restart reason=%2 target=%3'.[this.ship.idcode, if event.name == 'event_object_destroyed' then 'target_destroyed' else 'order_changed', $target]

debug_to_file.name: $_TSETraceFile
debug_to_file.text: '[TSE-TRACE] source=idle_follow ship=%1 phase=lifecycle event=order_return result=complete reason=%2 target=%3'.[this.ship.idcode, if not $target.isoperational then 'target_destroyed' else 'follow_failed', $target]

debug_to_file.name: $_TSETraceFile
debug_to_file.text: '[TSE-TRACE] source=idle_follow ship=%1 phase=lifecycle event=order_abort result=aborted reason=order_interrupted target=%2'.[this.ship.idcode, $target]
